_comment: Real restaurant menu (35 items). Short codes are the real Petpooja item ids; names/prices preserved exactly as the user provided for the original 34 (Water Bottle added since drivers commonly ask for it). At least 50 aliases per item, generated from curated seed terms (regional/colloquial names + likely driver shorthand) expanded with systematic spelling/phonetic variants (letter drops/doubles/swaps, common substitutions like c/k, ph/f, v/w) so the LLM matcher (llm_order_parser.py) has maximum coverage even for poorly-typed messages. Several prices are placeholders (1) pending verification in Petpooja. Edit freely -- no code change needed, the tool reloads this file on every message.
